paragraphs: Hi, I'm Jeffrey Kalsah Al Kautsar, a Fullstack Developer based in Indonesia 🇮🇩 focused on building modern and scalable web and mobile applications.
I'm experienced with React, Next.js, React Native, and Flutter to build responsive and user-friendly digital products, and develop backends using Node.js, Express, and Supabase.

I have a strong attention to application architecture, performance, and maintainability, and I'm familiar with working with databases like PostgreSQL and MySQL. I also understand the design process using Figma to ensure the right balance between functionality and user experience.
I'm committed to delivering digital solutions that don't just work well, but also have real value for users.
